Package hadur.bench

Class LogHarvester

java.lang.Object
robocode.control.events.BattleAdaptor
hadur.bench.LogHarvester
All Implemented Interfaces:
robocode.control.events.IBattleListener
public class LogHarvester extends robocode.control.events.BattleAdaptor
Collects what a battle looked like from the outside.
  • hadur.log: every line Hadur printed, prefixed with round and turn.
  • truth.log.gz: one T record per turn with both robots' true state and every live bullet, in the artifact's line format, and an F,round,turn,E,power record when an enemy bullet first appears.

Also measures wall-clock time per turn and counts skipped turns reported in Hadur's console output.
